entities.name: Query protein, 509 aa
observations: Sequence-derived analysis predicts a 50.84 kDa protein; Pfam detects YjeF_N (residues 24–198) and Carb_kinase (256–474).

Likely bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme Nnr, inferred from reviewed homologs with 39.1–42.5% identity and 84.9–99.6% query coverage; not directly experimentally established for this sequence.
Homolog annotation includes potassium binding and EC 5.1.99.6 epimerase plus EC 4.2.1.136 dehydration activities.

entities.name: NAD(P)HX epimerization
observations: Likely activity: (6R)-NAD(P)HX ⇌ (6S)-NAD(P)HX; NADHX and NADPHX epimers are both represented in homolog reaction records (Rhea:32215 and Rhea:32227).

entities.name: NAD(P)HX dehydration
observations: Likely activity: (6S)-NAD(P)HX + ADP ⇌ NAD(P)H + AMP + phosphate + H(+); represented for NADHX and NADPHX in homolog reaction records (Rhea:32223 and Rhea:32235).
